exp4: two demos x normal/mask_target/mask_other/mask_background/freeze_near; fixed milk language
mask: gray127 visible object bounding box both cameras
freeze: first planning time EEF-to-baseline-grasp-object center distance <= 0.12m; keep both camera frames thereafter
baseline_target: first bilateral grasp; if absent, first actual gripper contact (flagged separately); abort if neither exists
lift: object center rises >=0.03m from settled initial height
background_fallback: equal-area compact visible-background pixels when no same-size rectangle fits; flagged, never mask robot/objects
mask_area_budget: min(full visible object bbox area, available background area) per camera per observation, prioritized object pixels; target and background share this budget
baseline_distractor: Allow any of six objects as actual grasp target; observed tomato-demo ep12 grasps chocolate pudding. Other-object control remains milk for non-milk targets. Analyze this exception separately.
